ns2:section.sectionText: Prerequisite: Math 220 or 221 and CS 101 or equivalent programming experience. This section has a special focus on incorporating linear algebra concepts with computational tools in real world science and engineering applications. There is a required Python lab in place of a lecture on Fridays. For more details, please see https://go.illinois.edu/MATH415PL1 This Python section is permanently restricted to undergraduates, being a pilot for the future MATH 257, Linear Algebra with Computational Applications.
